warnings: The plan is an L-shape: a rectangle 500' x 200' with a 200' x 100' notch cut from the top-right corner.
The left vertical dimension is handwritten and could be read as 100' or 200'. I read it as 200' because it matches the two 100' dimensions on the right (100 + 100) and the overall height.
The hand-drawn outline lines do not quite meet at the corners, so the outline corners are estimated intersections.

The top-right 200' dimension measures from the notch's inner vertical edge to the right edge. Its p1/p2 are placed at y=458, the level of the right edge's top corner, because the notch is open at the top.
